  path={"/management/devices/fleets/{fleetId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



FindByFleet handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve device records associated with a specific fleet.
It expects the fleet ID as a URL parameter, validates it, and returns a paginated list of devices
belonging to that fleet. Returns appropriate HTTP status codes and error messages for invalid
fleet IDs or if no devices are found.
